Preserve marker cells and all unrelated background cells. This holds for single-cell gaps as well as longer gaps: a newly accepted 18×24 test (background 4, markers 8) had horizontal marker runs spanning gaps of several cells; every intervening cell between consecutive 8s in a row became 2, with other cells unchanged. # Continual-ARC demo discipline
